boundaries: A CPU fetch holds a shared lease and receives its word from the existing BRS/MRAM model.
Shared decode/trace/watchpoint and arithmetic handlers consume received words without another memory read.
The functional interpreter does not test a transfer flag on every ordinary data read.
Guest RP change cancels stale reads without an inferred implicit BRZ flush.
Non-arithmetic timed data transfers and complete automatic retirement remain unfinished.
Raw input-control AU timing and independently addressed BRCh storage remain unfinished.
Functional CERN/performance is compatibility evidence, not the full hardware OS gate.
